title: Experienced mom:
title_q: “A Fall and Winter Baby Care Routine”
title_short: Jordana · An Experienced Mom's Routine (no talking)
headline: One cozy fall day with a mom of two: dressing warm, a gentle nose clean with the BN02, snacks, a quiet hour, and bedtime with the WN02. No talking at all.
story: Momcozy wants a no-dialogue routine video of an experienced mom in fall and winter, with real care and products used the right way on the baby. Jordana does it the way she always does it: calm, quick, practiced. Two kids, one mom.

Fast, natural cuts from morning to night. The BN02 nasal aspirator and the WN02 white noise machine show up inside the routine, used for real, never explained. The reference Momcozy picked is a TikTok routine video: follow its rhythm, not its content.
Loops: L1 “How does she do it all?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the bedtime beat. Stakes: getting two little ones through a cold-season day calm and cared for.
do: Short cuts, 1 to 3 s each, morning to night.
Show the BN02 at the baby's nose, used gently, baby calm.
Show the WN02 being turned on at bedtime.
Keep the baby on camera in the product beats.
dont: No dialogue, no voiceover, no subtitles.
No baby resisting or crying at the aspirator.
No logo or name at 0:00. MOMCOZY only on the end card.
No monitor shots unless the baby is on its screen. The monitor on the kitchen counter (IMG_9448 02:42) has no baby on screen: do not use it.
